# Core Rule 4 - Players in vital job roles require a minimum amount of effort
As a head of staff you are expected to be competent.
If you need to leave the game for a non-emergency reason make sure to use cryo so another head of staff can spawn.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- It is ok to make mistakes as a head of staff. - It is ok to close the game if an emergency happens.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Don't consistantly make the same mistake over and over. - Close the game without first going to cryo unless its an emergency.
